title: Blue Armored Cyber Character
description: Two full-body poses of a young female character with short silver hair and blue highlights, wearing a dark blue armored outfit with glowing blue circuit patterns, large spiked gauntlets, knee pads, and a mechanical tail. She stands against a solid bright pink background in both a straight frontal pose with arms crossed and a dynamic crouched combat stance.
